about_short_description.short_description: Propel is a consumer technology company that offers a mobile app to improve financial health for low-income Americans

product.name: Providers App
product.description: A mobile application that helps low-income families manage their SNAP benefits and access related financial services.

product.name: Providers Tax
product.description: A free tax filing tool integrated with the Providers app, designed to help low-income households file taxes and claim refunds.

product.name: Medicaid Renewal Outreach Campaign
product.description: A multi-phase outreach campaign via the Providers app to assist Medicaid beneficiaries in updating contact information and maintaining coverage during Medicaid unwinding.

product.name: Affordable Connectivity Program (ACP) Support
product.description: Support and information provided through the Providers app to help eligible low-income households access discounted internet service via the Affordable Connectivity Program.

product.name: Model Context Protocol (MCP) for Propel
product.description: A capability that connects enterprise AI assistants and PLM agents to live product data in Propel and third-party MCP servers for real-time product decisions.
